fixed.B_GC_OBSERVATION: identical passive callbacks in all four cells
fixed.recovery_fit_or_repeat: No fit_once, repeat, retry-defer or earlier start-yield policy remains installed during service; true native baseline. Pinned qualification/compiler helpers may be reused without installing their service policy.
fixed.observations: Identical compact output capture, native completion/order/allocation/source observers, passive GC callbacks and recovery-start-gate evidence in both arms.
fixed.B_RECOVERY_START_GATE: native/wait_release according to fixed ABBA; sole policy variable is first recovery LOAD start timing

selection: Select the first natively allocatable first asynchronous recovery at the original boundary before prepare_load. Snapshot the requests RUNNING at that selection. Hold the selected native head until one request from that fixed cohort truly completes, or until the16-entry bound; other earlier native heads pass through.
scope: Exploratory action-value and strong-simple-explanation probe of ordinary capacity backoff, not an innovation or confirmation claim. The sole scientific variable is the first recovery LOAD start timing. Prior r05 re-preemption motivates this probe but its raw is not a performance control. Both native controls rerun on the same current GPU.

intervention.native: Original first asynchronous recovery start with identical opportunity/action observations; no policy break.
intervention.wait_release: At the selected request's original native waiting head, defer before prepare_load until a member of the selected RUNNING cohort truly finishes, or entry>=initial_step+16. Initial break counts within total<=16. Earlier native heads pass unchanged. No victim/new-admission/quantum change, queue movement, in-flight cancellation, added transfer concurrency or wall-clock threshold.

primary_readout: Join the legal selected recovery, requested/executed breaks, fixed RUNNING cohort completion or entry-bound release, first LOAD preparation/submission, scheduler ACK, scheduling and next output. Report all-request TTFT, completion, maximum generation gap, output throughput and fixed joint SLO, including failures/timeouts/unfinished. Preserve copy/output work, cumulative recovery unions, common GC, post-observation materialization and phase times. Deferred LOAD or reduced re-preemption is not itself an end-to-end benefit.
stop_rule: Planned native/wait_release/wait_release/native. If first wait_release action_count==0 or executed_breaks==0, stop before both reverse cells with explicit STOP_NO_ACTION, retain all collected raws and release the group lock. Missing action evidence aborts explicitly. Otherwise finish one fixed ABBA. No automatic repeats, parameter sweep or threshold tuning; different-run events are not matched-state controls.

resource_checks.disk_check_scope: Session/cache filesystem once after acquiring whole-group lock, before first warmup; no per-cell threshold. Source/model unchanged.
resource_checks.disk_basis: Completed r01 group raw581313352B + cache325036151B + archive40806407B =947155910B (<1GB). A2.5GiB=2684354560B prelaunch floor leaves1737198650B (~1.74GB) beyond that measured footprint. Model is cached and offline; no additional download. This is an executor disk floor, not GPU/HostKV budget.

storage_note: This session and independent empty caches use /tmp; retained model/source paths are unchanged. Require2.5GiB once after acquiring the whole-group lock and before warmup, with the original receipt and abort paths. No per-cell floor, model download or cleanup by this adapter.

gc_observation.clock: time.perf_counter host clock; align against raw measurement origin/end without altering raw timestamps
gc_observation.retained_events: All generation-2 collections and paired events lasting at least 0.001 seconds; this is logging detail, not a scheduling threshold.
gc_observation.short_event_accounting: per_generation aggregates cover the entire installation window; short events without individual timestamps cannot be exactly cropped to the raw measurement interval.
gc_observation.lifecycle: Record installation/uninstallation host time, GC enablement and thresholds; pair start/stop callbacks, retain pairing anomalies and pending_at_uninstall.
gc_observation.causal_limit: GC overlap is a common diagnostic, not a storage intervention in this group; callback intervals do not prove pure CPU pause cost or recovery-policy causation.
